title: HardwareSnapshot
description: A single point-in-time hardware sensor reading. All fields are nullable; null means the sensor is unavailable on this machine.

timestamp.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds when this snapshot was collected

error.description: Error description if this snapshot has partial or complete failure. Null when all sensors read successfully.

usagePercent.description: Total CPU usage 0-100. Null if unavailable.

temperatureC.description: CPU package temperature in Celsius. Null if no sensor available.

frequencyMhz.description: Current CPU frequency in MHz. Null if unavailable.

powerW.description: CPU package power consumption in Watts. Null if no sensor available.

name.description: GPU display name (e.g. 'NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060'). Null if no GPU detected.

usagePercent.description: GPU core usage 0-100. Null if unavailable.

temperatureC.description: GPU core temperature in Celsius. Null if no sensor available.

memoryUsedMb.description: GPU dedicated memory used in MB. Null if unavailable.

memoryTotalMb.description: GPU total dedicated memory in MB. Null if unavailable.

powerW.description: GPU power consumption in Watts. Null if no sensor available.

fanRpm.description: GPU fan speed in RPM. Null if no sensor available.

usedGb.description: Physical memory used in GB. Null if unavailable.

totalGb.description: Total physical memory in GB. Null if unavailable.

usagePercent.description: Memory usage percentage 0-100. Null if unavailable.

downloadBps.description: Download rate in bytes per second. Null if unavailable.

uploadBps.description: Upload rate in bytes per second. Null if unavailable.

readBps.description: Disk read rate in bytes per second. Null if unavailable.

writeBps.description: Disk write rate in bytes per second. Null if unavailable.

percent.description: Battery charge percentage 0-100. Null if no battery present.

charging.description: True if AC power connected and charging. Null if no battery present.
